title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit Calculation Standard: Dose-Change Supply
content:
**Calculation.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the dose-change supply is the number of days a dose-change override allows for the drug of the member's most recent quantity-limit approval. It is defined as follows.

1. The fill being re-dosed is the member's most recent paid retail claim for the drug.
2. The days of the fill being re-dosed run from its date of service, that date being day zero.
3. The dose-change supply is the days supply of the fill being re-dosed.

All quantities are whole calendar days.

## Worked figures (hypothetical records)

| Most recent paid retail claim for the drug | Dose-change supply |
|---|---|
| Ozempic, 28 days supply, dated day 0 | 28 days |
| Mounjaro, 30 days supply, dated day 10 | 30 days |
| Eliquis, 90 days supply, dated day 0 | 90 days |

## Reading the definition

- The drug is the drug of the member's most recent quantity-limit approval, and the fill is the most recent paid retail claim for that drug, dated by its date of service.
- The figure is a whole number of days; no fraction of a day arises.
